title: FoxxBoyy's Deepblackstone
description: A new material and many tools built from it that are stronger than netherite.
body:
This is my first mod, i had a problem with tools that break too quick, so i made my own tools. Also the blocks in this mod look great, so if you need something else to build with, go ahead and install this mod.
It shows that it's from PabloAnim's Block Mod, but that is the old name for the mod that i used in mcreator to make it lollll
